title: HTTP client retries permanent errors and never backs off
issue: Our outbound HTTP client is retrying 404s and hammering a rate-limited endpoint with no delay. 404 should fail immediately. 429 and 5xx should be retried, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS, with exponential backoff (BASE_DELAY_SECONDS * 2 ** attempt). tests/test_retry.py is failing. A patch that only stops retrying 4xx will still fail: 429 is transient, and backoff_seconds currently returns a constant.
gold_patch_hint: Two independent defects in app/http/retry.py. is_transient currently returns status_code >= 400, which retries 404/400/403; the correct rule is 500-599 or 429. backoff_seconds currently returns BASE_DELAY_SECONDS constantly; it must return BASE_DELAY_SECONDS * (2 ** attempt). A first patch that only tightens is_transient to status >= 500 will still fail the 429 and backoff tests, which is the point of this benchmark: the agent must diagnose the remaining failures and patch again.
expected_behaviour: patch is_transient (often the incomplete first attempt)
